title: The Note That Said Only 'I Saw You Try'
youtube_title: The Note That Said Only 'I Saw You Try' | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Remembering a kindness is a way of returning it.
summary: At a harbor shelter on the lee side of the wind, Opal notices that Neighbor Sami has already taken care of a note that said only that someone saw you try. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Opal does one useful thing Neighbor Sami did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
